title: apps/console/README.md links twice to CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md, deleted in c988277ff — and no link gate can see it, because check-doc-links.mjs does not scan apps/**
body:
Out-of-scope finding from #4143 (the console README version/spec line). Reported, not touched — #4143's ruling scoped that PR to the hand-written version claims.

## Fact (verified on `origin/main` = `d86d372ad`)

`apps/console/CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md` does not exist. `git log --diff-filter=D` puts its deletion at `c988277ff`. Two links in `apps/console/README.md` still point at it:

| Line | Text |
|---|---|
| 5 | `[Full Roadmap →](./CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md)` — the badge row |
| 126 | `[Console Roadmap](./CONSOLE_ROADMAP.md)` — the "Documentation" table, described as "Full development plan with phases, timeline, and verified status" |

Both resolve to nothing. The other three links on that page are fine (`../../content/docs/guide/console.md`, `../../content/docs/guide/console-architecture.md`, `./docs/UI_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL.md` all exist on disk).

## Why no gate caught it, which is the more interesting half

`scripts/check-doc-links.mjs` reports "Links are valid across 7 scan roots" on this exact tree. Its `SCAN_ROOTS` are `content/docs`, the root `README.md`, `examples/**`, `packages/*/README.md`, `docs/**`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `ROADMAP.md`. **`apps/**` is in none of them**, so every README under `apps/` is unlinted for links — `apps/console/README.md` and `apps/site/` alike.

That file's own header already anticipates this shape: it records that `QUICK_REFERENCE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `CHANGELOG.md "remain unscanned"`, and that objectui#3622 bought the package READMEs one `SCAN_ROOTS` row at a time. `apps/*/README.md` is the same one-row purchase, and by the same argument (the rule is `disk`, and an app README is read exactly like a package README).

## Two decisions, deliberately not made here

1. **What replaces the links.** The roadmap content is gone, not moved — there is no successor path to repoint at. Deleting both links, or repointing them at the root `ROADMAP.md`, are different answers and the second one asserts something about content nobody has checked.
2. **Whether to widen `SCAN_ROOTS`.** Adding `apps/*/README.md` is one row plus whatever it turns red. Worth measuring before committing to it — that is the durable fix, and this issue is the evidence that the hole is not theoretical.

## Searched for duplicates

`CONSOLE_ROADMAP`, `console README broken link`, and `check-doc-links apps` over open issues in this repo: no hits.
